m: कज् cl. 1. P. कजति, to be happy; to be confused with joy or pride or sorrow, Dhātup. vii, 58; to grow (in this sense a Sautra root).
a: कज् — {c1c} P. (कजति) 1 To be happy. --2 To be confused with joy, pride, or sorrow. --3 To grow (in the last sense a Sautra root.).

m: क—जासन m. ‘sitting on a lotus’, N. of Brahmā, Hcat.

s: i ruhe । janmani । sOtraDAturayam । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ i kaYjAraH । ruho janma । kfdDoH kaBAve iti BAve kaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
klI, (ke jale jAyate jAtaM vA । jana + karttari + qaH .) kamalam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: rohe(sOtraH)idit para॰ aka॰ sew । kaYjati akaYjIt cakaYja roho'tra janma tenAsyAkarmmakatA । kaYjAraH ।
na॰ ke jale jAyate jana--qa । paNkaje rAjani॰ ।
m: क—ज mfn. produced in or by water, watery, aquatic
क—ज n. a lotus, AgP.
क-ज See under 3. क.
कजिङ्ग m. pl. N. of a people, VP.

s: strI, (ku kutsitaM jalati jIvatIti । jala + wak NIp ca koH kat । yadvA kutsitaM rogayuktam jAlayati ArogyaM nayati । jala + Ric + ac gOrAditvAt NIz hrasvaSca । yadvA kajjalamivAcaratIti kad + jal + kvip + ac NIz ca .) matsyaviSezaH । tatparyyAyaH । kajjalA 2 anantA 3 iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ miSritarasaganDakam । (yaTA “ganDakena rasaM prAjYaH sudfQaM marddayedBizak । kajjalABo yaTA sUto vihAya GanacApalam ॥ dfSyate'sO tadA jYeyo mUrcCito rasakovidEH । asO rogacayaM hanyAdanupAnasya yogataH” ॥ iti vEdyakarasendrasArasaMgrahaH ॥)
m: कज्जली f. Aethiops Mineralis, L.
ink, L.
कज्जली-तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha.

s: klI, (ku kutsitaM jalaM yasmAt SuBramapi jalaM saMyogAt svavarRatvaM nayatIti yAvat yadvA kutsitaM UrdDvagaM cakzuzorjalaM dUrIBUtaM BavatyasmAt । koH kadAdeSaH .) aYjanam । iti hemacandraH ॥ kAjala iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । locakaH 2 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (“tataH sAkArayadBUri cewIBiH kuRqakasTitam । kastUrikAdisaMyuktaM kajjalaM tElamiSritam” ॥ iti kaTAsaritsAgare । 4 । 47 ॥ taTA, BAgavate 6 । 2 । 27 । “DiNmAM vigarhitaM sadBirduzkftaM kulakajjalam” ॥)
puM, (kat kutsitaM yaTA taTA jAlayati AcCAdayati AtapAdikaM । yadvA kutsitamapi latAgulmAdikaYceti yAvat jAlayati jIvayati varzaRenetiSezaH । ku + jal + Ric ac tato hrasvaH .) meGaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥
v: na॰ kutsitaM jalamasmAt koH kad । aYjane (kAjala) tasya saMyogAcCuBramapyudakamasituM BavatIti tasya taTAtvam aYjanaSabde 94 pf॰ vivftiH । “sakajjalaM tAmraGawe ca GfzwaM sarpiryutaM tutTakamaYjanaYca” suSru॰ । “gANgamambu sitamambu yAmunaM kajjalABamuBayatra majjataH” kAvyapra॰ । 2 leKanasADane dravye ca (kAli) “asitagiriniBaM syAt kajjalaM sinDupAtram” puzpadantastavaH । meGe pu॰ SabdamA॰ matsyaBedepuMstrI striyAM gO॰ NIz । Sabdara॰ । kajjalaM jAtamasya itac । kajjalita jAtakajjale tri॰ । vamaDyo'pi ekAkzarakoze'yaM paWitaH kajjalamivAcarati kajjala + kvip tataH ac gOrA॰ NIz 5 BiSritarasaganDake strI । svArTe kan tatrArTe “SudDaM sftaM taTA ganDaM Kalle tAvad vimardayet । yAvat sUtaM na dfSyeta kintu kajjalavat Bavet । ezA kajjalikA KyAtA vfMhaRI vIryyavardDinI । mABAnupAnayogena sarvavyADivinASinI” vEdyakam ।
m: कज्जल m. a cloud (in this sense perhaps for कद्-जल), L.
कज्जल f(आ, ई). a species of fish, L.
कज्जल n. lampblack (used as a collyrium and applied to the eyelashes or eyelids medicinally or as an ornament)
sulphuret of lead or antimony (similarly used), Suśr.; Kathās. &c.
(fig.) dregs, BhP. vi, 2, 27.
a: कज्जलं — [कुत्सितं जलमस्मात्प्रभवति, कोः कदादेशः] 1 Lamp-black or soot, considered as a collyrium and applied to the eyelashes or eyelids medicinally, or sometimes as an ornament; यथा यथा चेयं चपला दीप्यते तथा तथा दीवशिखेव कज्जलमलिनमेव कर्म केवलमुद्वमति K. 105; अद्यापि तां विधृतकज्जललोलनेत्रां Ch. P. 15; ˚कालिमा Amaru. 88. --2 Sulphuret of lead or antimony (used as a collyrium.) --3 Ink. --ली 1 Sulphuret of mercury, Æthiop's mineral. --2 Ink. --Comp. --ध्वजः a lamp. --रोचकः --कं the wooden stand on which a lamp is placed.

s: puM, (kajjalaM Dvaja iva yasya .) dIpaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: pu॰ kajjalaM Dvaja ivAsya । dIpe tri kA॰ ।
m: कज्जल—ध्वज m. a lamp, L.
कज्जल—मय mfn. consisting of lampblack, Hcar.

s: puM, klI, (kajjalaM rocayati । dIpenodBAsayati । kajjala + ruc + Ric tato'c svArTe kan । Rvul vA .) dIpADAraH । pilasuj derako ityAdi BAzA । tatparyyoyaH । kOmudIvfkzaH 2 dIpavfkzaH 3 SiKAtaruH 4 dIpaDvajaH 5 । iti jawADaraH ॥ jyotsnAvfkzaH 6 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: pu na॰ kajjalaM rocayati ci--Rici--ac । (pilasuca) । vaNgaBAzAyAM prasidDe । dIpADAre jawADa॰
m: कज्जल—रोचक m. n. the wooden stand or tripod on which a lamp is placed, a candlestick, L.
कज्जलिका f. powder (esp. made of mercury), Bhpr.
कज्जलित mfn. covered with lampblack or with a collyrium prepared from it g. तारकादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 36
blackened, soiled, Hcar.
a: कज्जलित — a. Covered with lampblack or with a collyrium prepared from it.

m: कज्ज्वल कज्वल vv.ll. for कज्जुल above.
a: कज्ज्वलं — Lamp-black (especially considered as an application to the eyes).

s: klI, (kaM UrdDvagataM cakzuzorjalaM cakzurogaviSezaM jvAlayati Sozayati nASayatIti yAvat । jval + Ric + ac hrasvaSca .) kajjalam । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
